abstract: Assesses subsea trenching machinery specifications and ROV pilot crew allocations
system_message:
You are the Subsea engineering superintendent (ENG), responsible for evaluating subsea trenching machinery specifications, ROV pilot crew allocations, and hydraulic power skid test certifications for candidate subsea cable maintenance consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hydraulic power skid certification（HYDR）
information_points.content:
ENG-HYDR-SSX：For Celtic Trench Engineering Consortium, the workshop test logbook reflects a continuous hydraulic power rating of 180 kW bench-tested on the primary seabed jet-trenching auxiliary power unit.
ENG-HYDR-BCW：For Nordic Marine Interconnector Group, the workshop test logbook for the primary seabed jet-trenching auxiliary power unit records a bench-tested continuous hydraulic power rating of 300 kW.
ENG-HYDR-B89：For North Sea Deepwater Joint Venture, bench testing of the primary seabed jet-trenching auxiliary power unit confirms a continuous hydraulic power rating of 240 kW in the workshop test logbook.

information_points.title: Assesses subsea trenching machinery specifications and ROV pilot crew allocations（TOOL）
information_points.content:
ENG-TOOL-1U5：For North Sea Deepwater Joint Venture, the subsea tracked mechanical jet trencher demonstrates a seafloor trenching depth rating of 300 m maximum rated seawater depth for sustained trenching and cable burial, and its technical technician deployment ledger indicates 260 worker-h of ROV pilot standby hours for the first 14 calendar days of contract standby rotation.
ENG-TOOL-GAF：For Nordic Marine Interconnector Group, the subsea tracked mechanical jet trencher has a seafloor trenching depth rating of 400 m maximum rated seawater depth for sustained trenching and cable burial, and the technical technician deployment ledger records 260 worker-h of ROV pilot standby hours across the first 14 calendar days of contract standby rotation.
ENG-TOOL-2B1：For Celtic Trench Engineering Consortium, the subsea tracked mechanical jet trencher has a seafloor trenching depth rating of 200 m maximum rated seawater depth for sustained trenching and cable burial, while committing 160 worker-h of ROV pilot standby hours over the first 14 calendar days of contract standby rotation.
